2. /gosellr → browse 15 seeded products → pick one → add to cart
3. /checkout → escrow locks EHBGC-simulated funds → order created
5. Login as DMO manager → /dmo/riders → see 3 online riders
7. Rider POSTs delivery events → status advances to 'delivered'
8. Buyer clicks 'Confirm delivery' → commission auto-settles (70% seller, 10% rider, 10% EHB, 10% franchise split 40/25/20/15)
9. /complaints/file → DMO sees in /dmo/complaints with tier chip
10. Click 'Uphold + penalize' → penalty ladder: warn → fine → STL -2
11. /crb/exams → take MCQ → pass → CRB level up + on-chain certificate hash
